method: Horseshoe VLM, 4 chordwise rows x N spanwise strips (multi-row lattice)
limitations: Induced drag plus optional constant CD0

messages: VLM-V8: reference area, chord and moment reference are the bounds-seed placeholder (geometric-bounds heuristic with A320-tuned constants, DR-36); reference-dependent coefficients are unvalidated estimates.
fit: C_Lalpha is "insufficient linear data" — 2 converged point(s) in the |alpha| <= 5 deg window; at least 3 are required (DATA_CONTRACTS 2.5). No C_Lalpha derivative is reported.
fit: C_malpha is "insufficient linear data" — 2 converged point(s) in the |alpha| <= 5 deg window; at least 3 are required (DATA_CONTRACTS 2.5). No C_malpha derivative is reported.
